## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.25mg/kg over 14 days | Close monitoring |
| **G6PD Deficient** | Based on risk-benefit assessment, PQ 0.75 mg/kg weekly for 8 weeks | Close medical supervision |
| **If no testing available** | Not specified | Not specified |
